motivation_and_chronology.known_prior: The frozen 8B and Llama-3.3-70B full320 orthogonalized-C transfer study returned POSITIVE_REPLICATION before this extension was designed. Its mean high-minus-low effects were 0.7485359547 and 0.6816911266. The full320 and pilot80 observational activations for Llama-3.1-70B were also previously inspected, but no matched orthogonalized-C intervention outcome has been generated for this checkpoint.
motivation_and_chronology.prospective_unknown: Whether the exact same pilot-train/full320-transfer intervention contract reproduces in meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct revision 1605565b47bb9346c5515c34102e054115b4f98b.
motivation_and_chronology.scientific_role: Prospective new-checkpoint model extension after a known positive result; not part of the original two-model decision and not independent confirmation of the source bank.

model.layer_rule: Carry forward the frozen normalized-depth mapping used for Llama-3.3-70B; do not select layers from Llama-3.1-70B outcomes.
model.hardware: four NVIDIA H100 80GB GPUs for extraction, shakedown, and causal execution

pilot80_training.role: Fit cross-fitted A/B/C directions, common residual scales, random controls, and target readouts exactly as in the v3 plan builder.

full320_transfer.role: Causal transfer test only; no direction, scale, layer, or readout fitting.

plan_contract.pilot_cross_fitting: The unchanged 25 folds: five held purpose families crossed with five stable topic-stratified payload folds; disjoint direction, readout, and test blocks.
plan_contract.orthogonalization: For every fold/source layer, replace C with C minus its least-squares projection onto span(A,B), computed before any Llama-3.1-70B transfer outcome. Preserve A, B, random controls, common residual scale, target readouts, folds, and rows unchanged.
plan_contract.full320_binding: Use the same full320 payload-fold domain as the two-model study, copy pilot-trained orthogonalized C, random controls, scales, and readouts without refitting, and evaluate every stated row exactly once.

interventions.delta: sign*alpha*pilot80 common residual scale*unit(orthogonalized C); random controls use alpha=1 and the frozen per-fold random bank

activation_gate: Before intervention scoring, an outcome-blind eight-row shakedown must pass. In the full run, every unsteered source and target vector must match stored deterministic full320 activations with max_abs<=0.125 and cosine>=0.999. Any failure invalidates the model extension; no partial analysis or tolerance changes.

analysis.primary_estimand: At alpha=1, mean payload-block purpose-interaction response at source layer 74 minus source layer 13 under the pilot-trained orthogonalized C direction.
analysis.primary_test: One-sided one-sample t-test across 80 payload blocks against zero.
analysis.supporting_high_test: One-sided one-sample t-test across 80 layer-74 payload-block C responses against zero.
analysis.random_specificity: The primary C mean must exceed the 97.5th percentile of the absolute means of the 32 frozen random-direction high-minus-low effects.
analysis.decision_rule: POSITIVE_MODEL_EXTENSION only if primary mean>0 with one-sided p<=0.05; layer-74 mean>0 with one-sided p<=0.05; alpha=0.5 high-minus-low mean>0; and alpha=1 primary mean exceeds the random 97.5th-percentile threshold. Otherwise CLEAN_NEGATIVE_OR_MIXED_MODEL_EXTENSION unless an integrity gate fails, which is TECHNICALLY_INVALID.
analysis.descriptive_robustness: Report all 16 topic means and all 16 leave-one-topic-out means, plus comparison to the already-known two-model effect range. These do not alter the decision.
analysis.one_shot: Run once only after a complete runner manifest exists. Do not inspect partial records.

claim_scope.allowed_if_positive: The fixed pilot-train/full320-transfer orthogonalized-C internal causal response extends prospectively to the frozen Llama-3.1-70B checkpoint, preserving the predeclared high-versus-low layer ordering with dose and random-control support.
prohibited: reinterpretation of the completed two-model result

stopping_rule: Complete both extraction archives, freeze their hashes into executable pilot and transfer configs, build and orthogonalize the pilot plan, pass the shakedown, and complete the full causal run before analysis. Preserve and stop on any failure; never relax a gate or analyze partial output.
